name: Operator Profile
description: Personalizes the TPM: your name for the greeting, and an optional persona (voice/tone). An empty persona means default behavior.

userName.label: Your Name
userName.description: Your name, used to personalize the greeting (e.g. 'Good evening, Alex'). The bootstrap composes it with the time-derived salutation to address you by name at session start and where it reads naturally. Leave empty to use no name — the salutation is then time-only with no name.

persona.label: TPM Persona
persona.description: An optional voice/tone/personality overlay for the TPM's user-facing communication (greeting, discussion, phrasing). A non-empty value flavors HOW the TPM talks to you throughout the session; it rides on top of the immutable cores and hard rules and can never relax the safety floor, change engineering discipline, or authorize anything the default TPM couldn't do. An EMPTY value means no persona — the TPM behaves with its default voice, identical to this module being off.

personaIntensity.label: Persona Intensity (0-10)
personaIntensity.description: Master strength dial (0-10) for how strongly ANY configured persona colors the TPM's user-facing voice. 0 = persona effectively off (default TPM voice even if a persona is set); 5 (default) = moderate, clearly the persona but balanced with clarity; 10 = persona at maximum. Higher = the persona's voice/tone/mannerisms come through more strongly. Applies to the operator-profile persona AND other modules' persona overlays (e.g. integration.bitbucket-pr-comments's coderabbitReplyPersona). Only matters when a persona is actually set — an empty persona means the dial does nothing. It changes only HOW strongly the persona colors the voice, never what the TPM does, is allowed to do, or the safety floor.
